FROZEN_TARGET.statement: Determine on the exact reachable HPS fixed-completion family whether Pi_24,int^(4) factors through the already-frozen old state, requires historical contrast D_14 relative to the smaller state, contains one genuinely new C4 information direction, or remains open. Independence requires reachable future-equivalence evidence; failure to find a formula is not authority.
forbidden_scope: derive K_C0 to K_C1 determinant update

IMPORTED_PROVED_STATE.Theta_3: C3(v,u,b_1;K) in the frozen predecessor semantics

OLD_STATE_SIGNATURE.domain: one exact reachable fixed completion H in the frozen local HPS scope
OLD_STATE_SIGNATURE.canonical_choice_reason: Use (Theta_3,Omega_0,Omega_1) to avoid redundant weighted coordinates during the reachable-fiber test.

PI_MAP.K_rule: K_C1(H) must be the actual conditioned local middle matrix belonging to the same reachable completion H.
forbidden_surrogates: generic exterior-algebra counterexample outside the reachable HPS family
different physical completion than the one defining sigma(H)

BAR_CONTRAST_EQUIVALENCE.firewall: A D14-necessity witness relative to (Theta_3,OmegaBar_14) is different from a Pi-independence witness relative to the full old-state signature.

REACHABLE_HPS_FAMILY.definition: The exact algebraic/discrete family of fixed completions reachable under the frozen STS31 HPS construction and the already-fixed tau12/tau13/tau23/tau14/tau24 local ordering, with all shared physical constraints respected.
REACHABLE_HPS_FAMILY.reachability_authority: Only actual HPS completions or an exact theorem about their reachable algebraic family may certify independence.

R4_WITNESS_SEARCH.first_scope: r=4 local HPS geometry supporting tau14 followed by tau24
R4_WITNESS_SEARCH.candidate_generation: Exact rational/algebraic reconnaissance is allowed only to generate candidates; every witness must be certified exactly.
R4_WITNESS_SEARCH.escalation_rule: Move to the next reachable family only if necessary and without broad random sweeps.

HISTORICAL_C0_INFORMATION_CONTENT.interpretation: The old pair determines an exact diagonal-sum combination and the real a-b cross contraction at A_0. These identities do not compare A_0 with A_1=Adj_4(K_C1).

THREE_DIRECTION_C4_DIAGNOSTIC_LENS.policy: Do not promote all entries of the compressed 3x3 compound block to state.

SAME_SIGMA_DIFFERENT_PI_TEST.semantic_reduction_claim: For every H,H_prime in R, sigma(H)=sigma(H_prime) implies pi(H)=pi(H_prime).
SAME_SIGMA_DIFFERENT_PI_TEST.name: PI_CONSTANT_ON_OLD_STATE_FIBERS
SAME_SIGMA_DIFFERENT_PI_TEST.falsifier: One exact reachable pair with same sigma and different pi
SAME_SIGMA_DIFFERENT_PI_TEST.Xi_firewall: Even if Pi is new, do not infer Xi as a whole is one new state direction because Xi=I_bar+M_bar and middle drift remains unopened.

SMALL_STATE_D14_WITNESS_TEST.firewall: This does not prove that the full old state (Theta_3,OmegaBar_14,D_14) is sufficient.

FIBER_CONSTANCY_TEST.semantic_question: Does pi factor set-theoretically through sigma on the reachable family R?
FIBER_CONSTANCY_TEST.formalization: Does there exist F_sem on sigma(R) such that pi=F_sem o sigma?

CONSTRUCTIVE_REDUCTION_TEST.P_allowed: Frozen known HPS parameters, exact weights and root data that are not hidden dynamic state.
requirements: exact equality on all reachable HPS states in scope
no K_C1 or equivalent unresolved conditioned object smuggled into F under another name

valid_independence_routes: exact reachable pair same sigma / different Pi
exact theorem that a reachable HPS algebraic family contains a degree of freedom with sigma fixed and Pi varying
invalid_routes: local Jacobian rank without upgrade to an actual reachable variation or exact algebraic-family theorem
REACHABILITY_CERTIFICATE.optional_elimination_view: Let R be the reachable family, sigma:R->C^3 and pi:R->C. The reduction question is whether pi factors through sigma.
REACHABILITY_CERTIFICATE.groebner_policy: Do not launch unrestricted elimination unless it is genuinely the smallest necessary test after exact reachable-witness search.

MIDDLE_DRIFT_SCOPE_FIREWALL.allowed: A reachable completion H may simultaneously determine K_C0(H) and K_C1(H) for purposes of comparing sigma(H) and pi(H).

COMPLEXITY_CERTIFICATE.constructive_reduction_requirement: Any resolver F must have polynomial representation size and polynomial bit complexity in r.

PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.PASS_PI24_EXACT_REDUCTION_TO_OLD_STATE: Only with an exact constructive polynomially representable resolver F.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.PASS_PI24_SEMANTIC_OLD_STATE_SUFFICIENCY: Only if exact fiber constancy on the reachable family is proved while constructive F remains unresolved.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.PASS_PI24_REQUIRES_D14: Only with the smaller-state reachable witness or equivalent exact theorem.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.PASS_PI24_ONE_NEW_C4_INFORMATION_DIRECTI: Only with same-full-old-state/different-Pi reachable witness or equivalent exact reachable-family theorem.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.OPEN_NO_PROOF_NO_FALSIFIER: If neither reduction nor reachable independence is certified.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.FAIL: Only a rigorous falsifier of the entire frozen local target, not failure of one search strategy.

EXACT_NEXT_MISSING_LINK.statement: On the exact reachable HPS family, decide whether pi is constant on old-state sigma fibers, construct an exact polynomially representable resolver if possible, or certify one exact reachable same-sigma/different-Pi witness; start at r=4 and do not use generic-K surrogates.

NEXT_SINGLE_GATE.scope: Execute only the frozen reachable-fiber reduction/independence target; no middle drift; no C5; no tau34.

SELF_HANDOFF_JSON.semantic_question: sigma(H)=sigma(H_prime) => pi(H)=pi(H_prime) on reachable HPS family
SELF_HANDOFF_JSON.D14_smaller_state_test: same Theta_3 and OmegaBar_14; different D_14 and Pi
